description: Org-authored rules — the Figma Context stand-in. Every generating surface reads these before producing output. Rules with enforcement 'judge' are checked deterministically by parity/judge.ts; 'agent' rules guide generation and are reviewed by humans. REVISED 2026-07-22 for Piqueray: three demo-era rules were REMOVED because they governed components this design system does not have — 'one-primary-action' (the Piqueray Button has no `primary` variant; its enum is default/orange/blanc/outlineBlanc/link/outilneNoir), 'layout-via-primitives' (no Stack or Inline exists here) and 'avatars-are-people' (no Avatar). A judge enforcing rules about absent components measures nothing. They were removed rather than rewritten: deleting a rule about a component that does not exist is bookkeeping, whereas authoring Piqueray's own composition rules is a design decision that belongs to the owner. The three that remain are system-agnostic and hold for any catalog.

rules.statement: Every UI element comes from the catalog. Unknown components are gaps to report, never to invent.
No literal colors or pixel values anywhere. All styling flows through design tokens (var(--…)) — and in screens, styling flows only through components.
Never use raw HTML elements the system provides a component for.
No className or style props on system components. If a component can't express it, that's a gap in the contract — report it.
